source(output(
		{Receipt Code} as string,
		{Receipt Reason} as string,
		{Payment Method} as string,
		{Vendor Reference Id} as string,
		{Subscriber Id} as string,
		{Group Id} as string,
		{Billing Group Id} as string,
		{Billing period} as string,
		Amount as double,
		{Check Number} as string,
		{Received Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> EXSRCINMMManualexcelfile
EXSRCINMMManualexcelfile derive(DC_Amount = toDecimal(Amount,19,19)) ~> DCNVINMMManualexcelfile
DCNVINMMManualexcelfile derive(BatchId = $BatchId,
		{Vendor Reference Id} = iif(isNull({Vendor Reference Id}), '', {Vendor Reference Id}),
		{DC_Subscriber Id} = toString({Subscriber Id}),
		{Payment Method} = iif(isNull({Payment Method}), '', {Payment Method}),
		{Receipt Reason} = iif(isNull({Receipt Reason}), '', {Receipt Reason})) ~> DERINMMManualexcelfile
DERINMMManualexcelfile split((!(isNull(Payment Method)) && length(Payment Method) != 0) || (!(isNull(Receipt Code)) && length(Receipt Code) != 0) || (!(isNull(Vendor Reference Id)) && length(Vendor Reference Id) != 0) || (!(isNull(Payment Method)) && length(Payment Method) != 0) || (!(isNull(Receipt Reason)) && length(Receipt Reason) != 0) || !(isNull(Amount)) || !(isNull(Check Number)) || !(isNull(Received Date)) || !(isNull(Subscriber Id)), disjoint: true) ~> CSPLNonEmptyRecords@(NonEmptyRecords,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
CSPLNonEmptyRecords@NonEmptyRecords sink(input(
		BillingGroupId as string,
		ReceivedDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BillingPeriod as string,
		SubscriberId as string,
		BatchId as integer,
		ReceiptReason as string,
		Amount as decimal(0,0),
		PayMethod as string,
		PaymentType as string,
		CheckNum as string,
		VendorRefId as string,
		GroupId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		BillingGroupId = {DC_Billing Group Id},
		ReceivedDate = {DC_Received Date},
		BillingPeriod = {DC_Billing period},
		SubscriberId = {DC_Subscriber Id},
		BatchId,
		ReceiptReason = {DC_Receipt Reason},
		Amount = DC_Amount,
		PayMethod = {DC_Payment Method},
		PaymentType = {DC_Receipt Code},
		CheckNum = {DC_Check Number},
		VendorRefId = {DC_Vendor Reference Id},
		GroupId = {DC_Group Id})) ~> SSDSTBOSSReceiptsExcelFile
